

| Terms and Conditions Raffle “The Click Draw” |
| :---: |

|  Section 1\. The raffle organizer The raffle is organized by: DataDiggers Market Research S.R.L., the main company, with the head office in Voluntari, Erou Constantin Pritopescu 9A, room no. 5, 2nd floor, Ilfov County, Romania, with the registration number J23/915/2015, VAT ID RO34246710, and checking account no RO97INGB0000999904897665, at ING Bank N.V. Amsterdam, Buzesti, represented legally by Paula Elena Pislaru, the Chief Operating Officer, also referred to as the „Organizer”. The raffle will take place in accordance with the provisions of this Regulation, which is mandatory for all participants. The organizer reserves its right to amend or change the rules, with the obligation to officially announce to the public, through the same manner as before.  Section 2\. Place and duration of the raffle "The Click Draw" contest will be held exclusively online, starting September 1st, 2025 and continues monthly with no predetermined end date, until terminated by the Organizer. Each “Monthly Period” runs from 00:00 to 23:59 (Europe/Bucharest time, EET/EEST) for the calendar month (e.g., September 1–30, October 1–31, etc.). At the start of each month, all entries reset.  Section 3\. Terms and conditions The raffle is accessible to everyone, regardless of nationality, residence, race, sex or religion, who comply with the conditions of this Regulation to validate their participation. Hoewever, employees of the Organizer and their first-degree relatives cannot participate. Participation in this raffle requires the fulfillment of the following conditions: Qualifying Surveys: For every survey started by a member that ends with “Screenout” or “Quota Full” or “Survey Closed”, the member receives one unique code \= one entry. Completed surveys, or any other statuses except “Screenout” or “Quota Full” or “Survey Closed”, do not generate entries. Unlimited entries per month: Members may earn one entry per qualifying survey with no monthly cap. Attempt limit per survey: Each member may attempt a given survey only once. Code delivery & entry: The unique code is shown in the member’s account and logged automatically. Members are auto-entered; no submission is required. No reclassification: Entries are assigned based on the survey status at the time it is recorded. Later reclassifications do not add or remove entries. The Organizer may audit and void entries suspected of abuse (including, without limitation, bots/automation, duplicate accounts, or behavior intended to artificially trigger screenouts/quotas/survey closed). *Otherwise, failure to comply with the aforementioned rules will result in automatic disqualification of the participant.* Participation in this raffle has the value of full acceptance, freely consented and outside of any constraint of the provisions of these Regulations. The right to participate belongs exclusively to the participant who meets the conditions imposed by the Regulation. The right to participate in the raffle is automatically revoked if a person provides false, erroneous or inadequate data or information in addition to personal data. The data provided will allow the participants to be informed of the prizes won and are necessary for the validation of the winners. Participation in this raffle constitutes full and unconditional acceptance of this Regulation.  Section 4\. Personal data protection According to Regulation (EU) no. 679 from April 27th, 2016 for the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data and the free movement of such data (named "GDPR"), applied from May 25th, 2018, MyVoice in relation with Data Diggers Market Research S.R.L, having the quality of an "Operator", processes your personal data in good faith and in pursuit of the purposes specified in this policy. By entering this raffle, you agree that MyVoice in relation to Data Diggers Market Research S.R.L will process the data regarding your full name and email address, in case you are among the winners. This information will be processed exclusively for the purpose of this raffle. More information on the processing of personal data, including the rights of data subjects, can be found on the MyVoice website:[https://myvoice-surveys.com/panelist/privacyPolicy](https://myvoice-surveys.com/panelist/privacyPolicy) More information on terms and conditions for panel membership, survey participation and use of services can be found on the MyVoice website:[https://myvoice-surveys.com/panelist/terms](https://myvoice-surveys.com/panelist/terms) More information on regarding our cookie policy can be found on the MyVoice website:[https://myvoice-surveys.com/panelist/cookie\_policy](https://myvoice-surveys.com/panelist/cookie_policy)  Section 5\. The raffle mechanism The members of the MyVoice panel will find out about the organization of the Raffle on the [MyVoice website](http://www.myvoice-surveys.com/), on the [social media pages](https://linktr.ee/myvoicebyddsocial), in the MyVoice newsletter or from other campaign communication channels. Registration is automatic: any member who earns a qualifying entry (see Section 3\) during a Monthly Period is entered in the draw for that Monthly Period. Entries only count in the month they were issued and do not carry over after month-end.  Section 6\. The prizes Monthly, the Organizer awards 11 fixed prizes as follows: 1 prize × 50 EUR/USD 10 prizes × 10 EUR/USD each *The total value of the prize is 150 euros (or equivalent in dollars).* VAT and all related fees will be borne by the Organizer. Prizes are paid in EUR or USD depending on the member panel, credited to the MyVoice member account. The winners of the prize offered in this raffle do not have the opportunity to receive the cash value of the prize or its exchange with other goods.  Section 7\. The nomination of the winner For each Monthly Period, winners are selected purely at random from all valid entries using random.org. One prize per person per month (winners selected without replacement). The draw, announcement, and prize crediting for a Monthly Period will occur before the end of the following month (e.g., September draw by October 31).  Section 8\. The notification and the receipt of the prize Winners will be notified by email (primary) and may also receive a dashboard message in their MyVoice account. By participating in this raffle, participants agree that, in case of winning, the identity of the winner and the awarded prizes will be publicly announced and/or used for advertising purposes, without other obligations or payments from the Organizer. If the winners do not send the information requested by the Organizer within 72 hours or if they have provided incorrect/incomplete contact data, the prize will be awarded to another participant, through a new draw. To receive the prize, the winners must send the Organizer a copy of the ID card.  Section 9\. The end of the raffle This raffle continues monthly until terminated. The Organizer may modify, suspend, or terminate the raffle and/or this Regulation through the same channels used for announcements. In case of force majeure or events making continuation impossible or illegal (including applicable sanctions or legal restrictions), the raffle may be suspended/terminated immediately. Changes do not affect entries already earned; any ongoing Monthly Period will be handled as communicated in the notice.  Section 10\. Raffle rules The regulation is available for free on MyVoice. By participating in this raffle, participants agree to comply with this Regulation. Any changes to this Regulations will be communicated on MyVoice’s social media accounts or on its main [website](http://www.myvoice-surveys.com/).  Section 11\. Disputes In case of disputes between the Organizer and the participants in the raffle, they will be settled amicably. If it is not possible to resolve the disputes amicably, the involved parties will submit the dispute for settlement to the competent Romanian courts.
